svg.title: Commutation Overlap, state 4: T2 + T3 + T6
svg.desc: Editable SCR inverter conduction paths. Red highlights electrically closed forward-only SCR loops. In inverter operation, current enters DC+ and leaves DC-; the external DC source provides energy to the AC grid. Overlap shows connectivity, not instantaneous current sharing.
